aggregate_fidelity.scope: Declared synthetic integer-count signals only; not original Table III reproduction, physical measurements, encryption/decryption evidence or a full-system certificate.

summary.estimand: Descriptive equal-case means over declared synthetic family/seed cases, with no confidence interval, independent-sample or population-performance claim.
summary.scope: Declared synthetic integer-count signals only; not original Table III reproduction, physical measurements, encryption/decryption evidence or a full-system certificate.

verification.scope: Declared synthetic integer-count signals only; not original Table III reproduction, physical measurements, encryption/decryption evidence or a full-system certificate.

conditions: Each batch makes one choice from the declared 42 configurations, with at most two plaintext polynomials, before that batch's fresh encryption noises.
The next batch's honest encryption noises are independent of the past; shared key coefficients and dependent batch outcomes are allowed.
No source-subset selection after observing current-batch ciphertexts/noises.
The task horizon is a predeclared finite cap on attempts, not only successful deliveries; noise-regenerating retries and reencryptions consume attempts.
No arbitrary-history conditional, every-fixed-key, unlimited-lifetime, malicious-ciphertext, network, no-wrap or control guarantee is inferred.
budgets.scope: Finite-horizon joint random-key/history/fresh-noise decoding risk only.

decoding_horizon.scope: Finite predeclared attempt budget over joint random-key/history/fresh-noise probability; no every-fixed-key, conditional-history, unlimited-lifetime, network or control guarantee. Sage proof is consumed, not reexecuted here.

denominators.energy: Modeled CPU and radio-transmit joules over the complete run; assumed costs, no receive/listen/OS/full-protocol or physical energy measurement.
denominators.invalid_acceptance_fraction_per_admitted: Invalid accepted reports / admitted reports; retained explicitly for without_hve.
denominators.observed_residual_loss_fraction: One minus accepted delivery / admitted reports; invalid acceptance can misleadingly reduce this observed loss.
denominators.source_admission_fraction: Admitted reports / all raw source reporting opportunities; sampling suppression/controller stops remain visible.
denominators.statistics: Equal-weight means and sample SD across 20 paired seeds; packets/nodes are not independent statistical repetitions.
denominators.valid_delay_mean_s: Mean source-to-sink delay among valid delivered reports; not all offered reports.
denominators.valid_delivery_fraction_per_opportunity: Valid delivered reports / all raw source reporting opportunities in the configured measurement window.
denominators.wire: Complete-run transmitted bytes / all raw source opportunities, including protocol/model accounting; not just ciphertext payload.

recovery.scope: All runs right-censored; the configured observation interval is not an observed recovery time and must not be averaged as one.

network.scope: Previously published independent rank-6 synthetic campaign, identified by its frozen completion manifest; this is not the fresh CI campaign currently executing and is not original-paper reproduction.
network.verification_scope: CSV/summary/config/completion-manifest crosschecks; this report builder does not rerun the network or independently replay the companion raw archive.

payload_structure.scope: Same-rank mathematical payload comparison and ideal PHY lower bound only; not measured latency, full-protocol traffic reduction or energy savings.

provenance.scope: Relative public paths and SHA256 only. No workstation paths, usernames, hostnames, environment variables or original target files are consumed or exported.

security.scope: heuristic generic flattened-LWE estimates; not a module-specific, side-channel, implementation or worst-case proof
